newsitem.title: UK: Ofwat says UK water competition could be improved.
newsitem.headline: Ofwat says UK water competition could be improved.

text.p: The director of the UK water industry watchdog Ofwat said on Thursday that competition in the industry could be enhanced by suppliers competing for water resources.

Ofwat director Ian Byatt, speaking at the first annual meeting of the water and effluent forum, said, "Competition is more likely to thrive if suppliers or potential suppliers have reasonable access to the raw material - water."
Byatt also said he wanted to see more openess in the process around inset appointment applications.
The watchdog is currently considering 18 applications for inset appointments, 10 of these involve Ofwat determining a bulk supply or costs of a main sewerage connection.
Ofwat said that in future information about bulk supply costs or sewerage connections would be exchanged to allow comment.
"This increased transparency will have the benefit of inceasing the understanding of the issues, stimulating a debate on costs and speeding up the application process."
